descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S17 AI trace and timing for TC-20's AI steps (Save Note, Generate), plus time to full counts

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Each run records the build and which AI ran each AI step TC-20 exercises: the step-3 note (note model, and the backup model if one was used) and the pre-round processing behind Save Note (S08), so a … (UAT 3.1; UAT 3.9)
  • U8 Each Save Note and Generate run in TC-20 logs the AI call time (aiCallLog.providerMs) separately from the total (durationMs). Save Note targets 15 s or less in 9/10 runs. … (UAT 3.5)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given Local stack, standard fixture. A person runs one Save Note and one Generate Note & Finish per care setting (or reads the rows left by S08 and S09 once they run)

When After each Save Note and Generate, read the local aiCallLog rows for the fixture patient's calls (read-only, local stack only): model, fellBackFrom, providerMs, durationMs. Also time a cold dashboard load and the time from a status write to the tile moving

Then The run report names the build and, per call, the model that ran and the backup if one was used (3.1, 3.9), for the note and for the pre-round processing. Each call shows the AI time separately from the total (3.5). Save Note over 15 s, and any run over 30 s where providerMs is not most of durationMs, are flagged for review with Vikram. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.1 and 3.9 (record which AI ran each step) and 3.5 (AI time logged apart from the total; 15 s Save Note target; 30 s investigation limit). Timings are targets, not pass/fail: a slow run is flagged, never failed. U7 fails only if the trace is missing or contradicts what ran. …

Where it ran: local manual (time lane, a script does the person's steps); test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane manual.

Test method: PERF · Performance timing; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: manual.

UAT item: TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-20/S17

AI trace and timing for TC-20's AI steps (Save Note, Generate), plus time to full counts

Tickets: none (UAT only)

New local lane manual: status passed-partial in manual/results.json → passed (partly passed (every judged cell passed; part was not run / was mocked)).

How it is tested (manual/plan.json, automatable: partly): chromium spec. One real pre-round Save Note per care setting on a fresh account (real AI), then read diagnostics:list (the account's own aiCallLog rows: model, fellBackFrom, providerMs, durationMs) and time a cold dashboard load and a status write → tile move. Generate cell not run (forbidden locally; dev S15 records generateNote rows). — Save Note trace and timings are automatable; the Generate half is forbidden locally.

Detail:

6/6 judged cells pass, 4 recorded, 1 NOT RUN. Not run: Generate Note & Finish trace (both settings) (Generate is forbidden on the local stack (capabilities.json); dev S15 records notes.generateNote rows). Recorded: Hospital: Save Note time against the 15 s target / 30 s investigation limit = {"saveNoteWallMs":10403,"over15s":false,"slowNotVendor":[]} | Nursing Home: Save Note time against the 15 s target / 30 s investigation limit = {"saveNoteWallMs":12114,"over15s":false,"slowNotVendor":[]} | cold dashboard load (Hospital, 1 patient) = {"coldMs":6688} | status write → Complete tile moves = {"moveMs":1786,"beforeComplete":0}.

During the run (runNote): 1 of 3 runs: the Nursing Home Save Note left the text saved, with no summary and no error, for 90 s, during the same overload; not reproduced on rerun. Intermittent, not counted: in 4 Save Notes today (TC-20/S17 NH during the 14:4x overload; TC-21/S17 Hospital at 16:55; TC-11/S03 NH at 16:59 and 17:02 JST) the text was saved but the structured summary never arrived and no error was set within 90 s (preRoundProcessing stuck true, or no notesProcessedAt and no preRoundError); the retries were clean. No aiCallLog row was captured for those attempts, so the cause (model latency vs app) is open; worth watching on dev.

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — The given puts it on the local stack: it reads aiCallLog with the admin key (backend-read-admin) and times actions (action-timing); dev has no admin key.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
